qualificationMethod.freshness: Every G00-G25 case starts one fresh actual Godot invocation with its own verifier-originated challenge, HOME and output root.
qualificationMethod.baseline: G00-G14 and G19-G25 execute the exact canonical M09 baseline before the attack injector applies exactly the one declared post-capture attack transaction.
qualificationMethod.diagnostic: G15-G18 execute the same canonical Godot path against a deliberately read-only output root, producing a genuine failed observation open and non-empty Godot stderr before the declared stderr attack is applied.
qualificationMethod.surrogateBan: No case executes a surrogate executable, shadow script, shadow corpus or synthetic diagnostic. Substitution controls mutate untrusted post-capture evidence from a fresh real invocation and test independent rejection.
qualificationMethod.verifier: Every case is decided by the same unchanged independently bound verifier, then replayed once to require a byte-identical receipt.

authority.observerCommitRule: The workflow supplies and the verifier binds the exact trusted checkout commit independently of the untrusted statement.
authority.productCommitRule: The workflow supplies and the verifier binds the exact product main commit; every frozen semantic product role must still match and the packet commit must have this commit as its sole parent.

g0.semanticMechanism: Every declared semantic role was consumed by read or pread64. No declared semantic role was mmaped.
g0.identityMechanism: Executable and runtime objects were executed, read or mmaped and are content-bound separately from semantic roles.

trusted: GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04 VM kernel and runner boundary
pinned GitHub Actions and exact-main workflow tooling
packet ingester, capsule builder and Godot profile supervisor
untrusted: content-bound Godot, Sentry extension, shell, xdg-user-dir and project checkout
Godot process and every descendant or thread
external GDScript and corpus supplied by the research packet
statement, trace, byte sidecar, streams, output and replay packet supplied to the verifier
trustMap.separation: The independent verifier imports or calls none of the supervisor, campaign, tracer, Godot driver, external GDScript or diagnostic validator.
excludedClaims: malicious kernel, GitHub runner administrator or compiler resistance
arbitrary executable, arbitrary Godot project or arbitrary input-mechanism coverage
M07-M10, Gate O, E0, E1, balance, strategy, P9 or product evidence

budgetAccounting.authority: GitHub Actions API for this repository and workflow
budgetAccounting.attemptIdentity: every run attempt containing the exact job name Qualify actual Godot runtime profile, including the current attempt
budgetAccounting.reservationRule: Each admitted specialist attempt reserves its full 15-minute job timeout even if it finishes earlier.
budgetAccounting.hostedMinuteEquation: 8 attempts * 15 reserved minutes = 120 maximum hosted minutes
budgetAccounting.concurrency: All godot-runtime qualification dispatches share one non-cancelling concurrency group so the remote count cannot race.
budgetAccounting.failureRule: Missing current-job evidence, an incomplete remote listing or a ninth attempt fails closed before packet ingestion or any case.

clock.name: CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW
clock.startBoundary: immediately before the first traced child is created
clock.finishBoundary: after every traced task has been reaped
clock.ownership: external trusted supervisor and ptrace tracer

identitySet.rule: Every executed, opened or mapped regular runtime object must match one path, size and SHA-256 record. Device and inode are bound in the current receipt.

productReadSet.coverage: Every byte of every listed role must be observed through current read or pread64 events and byte-compared with the sidecar.
productReadSet.projectEvolution: The receipt records the exact invocation's main commit. A later exact product commit is admissible only when every listed path, size and SHA-256 remains identical and the packet commit has that exact main commit as its sole parent.

generatedGodotCache.derivation: Generated once before the traced invocation by the exact Godot binary against the exact read-only product, then content-checked against the frozen G0 manifest before the product is made read-only.

externalScript.pathRule: one regular non-symlink .gd file directly below the declared packet root

corpus.pathRule: one regular non-symlink .json file directly below the declared packet root

requestIndex.source: exact canonical argv after the second -- separator
requestIndex.qualificationRule: The qualification packet declares exactly index 0.
requestIndex.researchRule: A #421 packet declares a unique finite requestIndices list; every invocation is externally bound to one canonical member before spawn.

stdout.binding: actual write bytes, current file identity and final file bytes

stderr.binding: actual write bytes, current file identity and final raw bytes
stderr.semanticPolicy: The profile verifier does not interpret diagnostic meaning.

output.binding: fresh exclusive inode, actual write bytes, close, final size and SHA-256

research.authorityRule: The exact bound owner comment authorises A1-v2 only after an exact-main #535 PASS marker. A later packet-freeze comment may narrow the experiment but cannot replace this execution authority.
research.requiredCapabilityMarker: GODOT_RUNTIME_EXACT_MAIN_PASS head={productSha} tree={treeSha} profile_sha256={profileSha256} manifest_sha256={manifestSha256} run={runId} receipt_sha256={receiptSha256}

packetIngress.commitRule: The exact packet commit has the exact product commit as its sole parent and differs only below one declared packet root.
packetIngress.manifestRule: The packet manifest binds schema, exact product SHA, packet root, authority issue and comment, the finite canonical request-index list, role paths, sizes and SHA-256 values. The workflow independently binds the exact packet commit and its sole parent because a commit cannot content-bind its own SHA.
packetIngress.memberRule: Regular non-symlink data files only; no workflow, shell or Python file may enter from the packet ref.
packetIngress.executionRule: Trusted workflow and tools come only from the observer exact main. The product comes only from the exact product commit. Godot may load only the manifest-declared external GDScript and corpus from the packet.
packetIngress.mountRule: Product and packet are made read-only before the traced invocation; HOME and output are fresh and exclusive.
packetIngress.cleanupRule: The ephemeral packet ref is deleted after its terminal receipt is published.

accessGrammar.processes: One root that execs env then exact Godot, one measured sh descendant and one measured xdg-user-dir descendant; the valid path has exactly three processes, seven threads, ten tasks, four execve events, eight clone3 events and one vfork, and every task is reaped.

paths.successfulRegularFileRule: Every successful regular-file path must resolve to an exact semantic-read record, exact runtime-identity record, declared platform observation or one of the five declared outputs. A read-only root is not itself an allow rule.
paths.directoryProbeRule: Directory probes are limited to ancestors of exact admitted files plus the measured font, device, proc, product import/remap and packet import/remap grammar.
paths.symlinkRule: A system alias is admitted only when its resolved device, inode, size and content digest match one frozen runtime identity.
paths.writableDirectoryRule: mkdir is limited to ancestors of the three path-named outputs below the two fresh exclusive roots; no other file creation or write is admitted.

mappings.anonymous: permitted within the measured syscall and memory caps
mappings.runtimeIdentity: permitted only for an exact content-bound runtime identity, MAP_PRIVATE, within file bounds and never as a writable shared mapping

network.permitted: Exactly two AF_NETLINK sockets and binds with NETLINK_KOBJECT_UEVENT only, with no payload send or receive

accessGrammar.writes: Only fd 1, fd 2, observation.json, godot.log and sentry.dat are writable; every successful write is byte-captured and bound to the current lineage.

internalPipe.binding: Exactly one anonymous pipe carries this byte-exact payload once from the measured xdg-user-dir descendant to Godot; both positive write and read bytes are captured, share one device/inode identity and the pipe is closed at both ends. Outer stdout/stderr pipes are output transports, never semantic inputs.

decision.pass: G00 is ADMITTED; G01-G23 and G25 fail closed for their exact predeclared reasons; G24 is INCONCLUSIVE for PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE; every case uses the same independent verifier; the unchanged inert campaign also passes.
decision.fail: Complete evidence admits any negative, rejects G00, gives a negative the wrong reason, weakens a bound or exceeds either finite delivery budget.
decision.inconclusive: Actual semantic bytes, executable or runtime identity, process lineage, raw stderr, fresh output, zero-loss accounting or external time remains ambiguous outside the deliberate G24 control.
decision.repair: An implementation-only correction may retain every profile, trust, attack, cap and decision field, but invalidates the complete prior Godot campaign and consumes one of eight qualification attempts. A scientific, trust-boundary or acceptance change closes the profile rather than repairing it.
